description: research_shopping is the full verified-research job; find_products is the quick candidate-list tool. It runs as a background job and returns status "running" with a research ID while the minutes-long research continues; the same research ID returns the run on later polls until completion. Unsafe medical, legal, financial-advice, and professional-service asks return status "refused" before any work is queued. Completed runs return a researched recommendation with per-claim source receipts, or an explicit refusal when evidence is insufficient. Missing decision details return clarification questions before research starts. `market` biases discovery and marketplace checks toward seller pages serving that country; "available in <market>" means the seller page serves that market, not that stock is guaranteed. Example answer keys include {"budget":"500 USD","market":"US","category":"espresso machine"}.

answers.description: Answers to clarification questions. Set accept_defaults:true to accept budget and market defaults; it does not waive product type, use case, or must-have requirements.

market.description: Buyer market as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Biases discovery and marketplace checks toward seller pages serving that country; availability is not a stock guarantee.

need.description: Buyer need in natural language. Required when starting a new research run.

persona.description: Research persona; b2b produces a quotation/RFQ pack.

research_id.description: Existing research run identifier to read instead of starting a new run.

name: research_shopping

stage_counters.description: Progress counters for a running research job. Individual counters may be absent.

listings_checked.description: Market listing URLs recorded during commercial checks.

stage.description: Current pipeline stage identifier, or queued before work starts.

verified.description: Candidates examined during verification, not a count of candidates that passed.
